svg.aria-label: The 10c-dev build cycle. Invoking the implement skill on a ticket key moves the ticket to In Progress and feeds a large Build block with four numbered steps: the rung (R0 probe, R1 PoC, R2 MVP, R3 hardened), the interview with the developer, the tiny spec, and writing the code, which edits your checkout. Verify runs the app locally and loops back to step four when it fails. The diff is reviewed with a code-review skill adapted from Open Mercato, then an optional adversarial critic drives the running app: FAIL returns to step four, PASS goes on, and the critic can be skipped. Commit and push asks first and happens only on your yes; the ticket then moves to In Review on staging and waits until a human checks it in production — yes reaches Done, a bug opens a new ticket while this one stays In Review. Markers show which steps write outside the chat automatically and which ask first.
svg.title: The 10c-dev build cycle
